reason: This plugin’s user-facing function is to let DSH agents archive and read X/Twitter posts by calling the x.2100laike API through a single `x_archive` tool, returning markdown snapshots plus metadata and optional re-capture support, which makes it primarily an external service integration utility rather than a local editor or system tool.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH Agent 提供 `x_archive` 工具，可将 X（Twitter）推文链接提交到归档服务并返回可读的 Markdown 快照及相关元数据。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an `x_archive` tool for DSH agents to archive and read X/Twitter posts through an external service, returning the result as Markdown snapshots with associated metadata.

capabilities: Fetches and archives X/Twitter URLs via configured HTTP API endpoint
Returns structured archive metadata and Markdown post content
Supports optional forced refresh of an archived post
